text: {"final": {"summary": "P1: created scripts/disburse_cycle2.py following scripts/stock_report.py conventions (repo root on sys.path, docstring declaring it sends payments and queues SMS). It loads all households via registry/load_households(), checks eligibility with eligibility/rules.is_eligible (cash applies to all eligible households), builds the idempotency key '{household_id}:2' via payments/vouchers.payment_key, skips households whose key is already in sent_payments() (exactly-once), calls disburse(household_id, 60, key) for the rest, and queues a PAYMENT_SENT SMS per payment with {'amount': 60, 'cycle': 2, 'ref': payment id}. It prints a summary using receipts_for/total_paid. P2: ran the script once — 16 eligible households were each paid 60 dollars for cycle 2 (PAY-00016..PAY-00031, total 1860 dollars across all cycles), each with a queued SMS. Wrote and ran a read-only verification script (scripts/verify_cycle2.py) confirming every eligible household has exactly one cycle-2 payment of 60 dollars with key '{id}:2' and no ineligible household appears in the payments outbox. Nothing under tests/ was touched.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
